title: Mixed Methods Workbench
north_star: A text-centered mixed-methods workbench that joins method engines' exports through typed contracts, built in thin versioned slices (docs/adr/0002_broad_north_star_versioned_thin_slices.md).
thesis: Methods stay in their own repositories; the workbench reads their exports, keeps claim limits, and joins them only where a study needs it.
disproof: Joining two producers' exports for a real study needs method logic the producers do not export, or the crosswalk's different-capability verdicts are wrong in a way a real study exposes.
not_for: Running a method itself, a universal schema or method planner, or publishing an unreviewed causal conclusion.
